name: Thieves' Guild
desc1: This large, smoky room is filled with a half-dozen tables. Seated at
desc2: these are scruffy-looking men playing various games of chance. As you
desc3: approach, the room quiets down as everyone begins whispering, and you
desc4: receive a few hard stares. You can exit through doorways to the south
desc5: and west. There is a trapdoor set in the floor here.
